awaiting: The labels are written. The prose — tagline, about1, about2, about3, growBody, appNote — is still null and still English, on purpose: it is the site's own writing rather than the app's, and it is read in English before it is commissioned in sixteen languages. A null value is drawn in English, silently, one key at a time; the English is in assets/js/strings.js.
